import sys

def icpc_student():
    i_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not i_data:
        return
    
    t = int(i_data[0])
    index = 1
    
    out = []

        n = int(i_data[index])
        index+=1
        
        n3 = 3*n
        a = [int(x) for x in i_data[index : index+n3]]
        index += n3
        
        a.sort(reverse = True)
        
        prefix = [0]*(n3+1)
        for j in range(n3):
            prefix[j+1] = prefix[j]+a[j]

            high = left_max-1

                v2 = a[idx1]+a[idx2]

                    left_best = mid
                    low = mid+1
                else:
                    high = mid-1
